evals.expected_output: Evaluation report for Priya Nair. Should detect Tech track, 7 years / Mid-Senior. Should rate Intellectual Honesty as Concern (cannot name a failure). Recommendation should be Proceed with Caveats, with next round probing ownership depth and whether the pattern of deflection on failure is consistent.

assertions.name: detects-tech-track
assertions.description: Report identifies this as a Tech role evaluation

assertions.name: flags-cv-inconsistency
assertions.description: Report notes the CV vs transcript inconsistency (claimed single-handed architecture, tooling actually built by Suresh)

assertions.name: intellectual-honesty-concern
assertions.description: Report rates Intellectual Honesty as Concern or Weak, citing inability to name a meaningful failure

assertions.name: recommendation-not-proceed
assertions.description: Recommendation is not a clean Proceed — either Proceed with Caveats or Decline

assertions.name: cites-transcript-evidence
assertions.description: Report quotes or specifically references moments from the transcript as evidence for at least 3 dimensions
